title: California Medical Board Primary Source Rule
source: CA Business and Professions Code Sec 2080
content: Physicians practicing in California must maintain an active, unexpired license issued by the Medical Board of California. Expired or suspended licenses prohibit clinical practice.

title: New York Office of Professional Medical Conduct
content: Any formal disciplinary charges or consent agreements filed by NY OPMC require full credentialing committee review before network participation authorization.

title: Texas Medical Board Encumbrance Policy
content: Agreed orders, probation, or practice restrictions imposed by Texas Medical Board constitute exceptions that demand risk assessment and peer review prior to committee signoff.
